snippet.title: Double Skunk Cribbage Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Real cribbage. Mostly.

Double Skunk is a cribbage roguelite. Play the real game, six-card deal to the last count, then build an engine between hands out of powerups, rank cards and pegs. Climb the Long Tally from a back-room parlor to the national championship, and keep going after it.

Everything in this trailer is real gameplay, recorded from actual matches.

What's in the game:
- Cribbage played straight: deal, cut, peg, show, crib, and Muggins for players who want the count to bite
- 57 powerups, 26 rank-card consumables and 10 pegs that change the rules of the run
- A 21-rival campaign up the Long Tally, with trophies, recoverable losses and an endless climb past the top
- A board with prizes on it, across six venues from a candlelit parlor to open space
- A weekly challenge: one deal for everyone, thirty hands of duplicate cribbage, ranked on margin
- Online matches against friends and strangers, or offline play against four skill tiers of rival

Coming Soon to Early Access. Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4783460/

Available in English, German, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese and Italian.

Made by Kerrberry Games.
